portInfo.description: Naha Port is Okinawa’s historic gateway, once a Ryukyu trading hub toward China and Southeast Asia, now a tourism and commerce harbour. MLIT notes Kokusai-dori (International Street) is about a 20-minute walk from Naha Cruise Terminal, with Tsuboya pottery street and Makishi Public Market among nearby attractions. Published location lines include Wakasa and Minatomachi areas of Naha. Berth length/depth were not on the captured guide page.

facts.established: Established as the capital of Ryukyu Kingdom

climate.description: Subtropical climate with mild winters and hot, humid summers

politics.visaRequirements: Visa-free for many nationalities (15-90 days depending on nationality).
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required. Some nationalities need visa in advance.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Heat and humidity high — hydrate for the Kokusai walk.
